test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which agency has built and is maintaining the Leh-Manali Highway?

options.text: National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation (NHIDCL)

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Border Road Organisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Border Road Organisation (BRO) is a road construction executive force in India that provides support to and is a part of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• It is responsible for developing and maintaining road networks in India's border areas and friendly neighboring countries.
 
• BRO plays a crucial role in the infrastructure development of border areas, which is vital for the strategic and operational needs of the Indian armed forces.
 
• The Leh-Manali Highway is one of the most important projects undertaken by the BRO, facilitating connectivity between the northernmost region of India and the rest of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh State Highway Authority**

 
 
• This authority is responsible for the maintenance and development of state highways within Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It does not handle national highways or strategic roads like the Leh-Manali Highway.
 
 
 
• **National Highway Authority of India (NHAI)**
 
 
• NHAI is an autonomous agency of the Government of India, responsible for the management of a network of over 50,000 km of National Highways in India.
 
• It primarily deals with the construction, upgradation, and maintenance of national highways.
 
 
 
• **National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation (NHIDCL)**
 
 
• NHIDCL is a fully owned company of the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, Government of India.
 
• It is responsible for the development and maintenance of national highways and strategic roads, primarily in the northeastern region of India.
 
 
 
• **Border Road Organisation (BRO)**
 
 
• The BRO is a part of the Indian Armed Forces and is responsible for the construction and maintenance of roads in the border areas of India.
 
• It was formed on 7 May 1960 to secure India's borders and develop infrastructure in remote areas of the north and northeastern states of the country.
 
• The organisation is also involved in the construction of airfields, bridges, and tunnels.
 
• The Leh-Manali Highway is one of the most notable projects undertaken by BRO, significantly improving connectivity and strategic mobility in the region.
